The full suite is green — all 26 tests pass, including the checkpoints affected by this change.

## Summary

I changed the `customerCode` format from `<LAST3>-<NNNN>` (global sequence) to `<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>` with a per-city sequence, in `OwnerRestControllerV1.java`:

- **`nextCustomerCode`** now takes both `city` and `lastName`. It builds `CITY3` (upper-cased first three letters of the city) and `LAST3` (upper-cased first three of the last name), and computes `NNNN` as a 4-digit zero-padded sequence equal to **one more than the number of owners already in that same city** (matched case-insensitively via the existing `normalizeForHousehold` helper).
- Added a small `prefixThree` helper for the shared "upper-cased first three letters" logic.
- Updated the call site to pass `owner.getCity()`.

Everything derived from `customerCode` rebuilds automatically: `Owner.getMembershipNumber()` already formats `"%s-M%02d"` from `customerCode`, so it now carries the city prefix without any change there (verified by Cp14).

No migration of stored data was needed — the change is at generation time, and the tests are transactional/black-box over the create+read endpoints.
